_what: TICKBURST_PROVE_MANY_TICKS_ONE_FRAME continuous-checkpoint bounds (final.md §2.3), committed before any equivalence result. tickburst_bench.py compare(): a flattened checkpoint key matching a `continuous` rule's regex (first match wins) may differ by max(abs, rel * max(|a|,|b|)); every other key is DISCRETE and must match exactly; a key matching `ignore` is not compared; NaN never matches. A bound is loosened only by a new commit that says why, never mid-trial.
_why_these: fluid totals and stored energy integrate many per-tick updates and are read at matched ticks, so R (unpaused, overshoots its target by a few ticks) can drift by a few ticks' worth; 2% / 1 unit covers ~10 ticks of a hose pump at its rated flow and a battery's charge rate. Counts, membership, flags (glowOnInt, established, descentCount, pit occupants, power-net membership, thing counts by def) stay exact.
